keys.label: Guest rooms (keys)
keys.assumption: The research gives no subject program. 80 keys sits inside the 42 to 114 key range of the eight branded hotels operating in Bastrop [^33,38,23] and below the 121 keys filed for the Fairfield and Staybridge project [^20].

site_acres.label: Site area, acres
site_acres.assumption: A 2.5-acre hotel pad is under contract at Sendero [^22]; 3.0 acres leaves room for surface parking and detention on a highway pad.

land_per_acre.label: Land price per acre
land_per_acre.assumption: 2026 asking price of the SH 71 frontage corridor tract the research identified, about $308,000 an acre; the listing is not cited so that no real parcel is identified. An appraisal sets the value.

hard_cost_per_key.label: Building and site work per key
hard_cost_per_key.assumption: Owner estimates filed with TDLR put construction value at $13.0 million for the 114-suite Everhome (2023) and $10 million for the 121-key Fairfield and Staybridge (2026) [^16,20]; those filings omit FF&E and soft costs. HVS puts the 2025 limited-service median at $170,000 to $197,000 per room all-in [^48]. We carry $125,000 per key for building and site work, above the local filings, because the Turner index rose 4.8% over the trailing twelve months [^48].

soft_pct.label: Soft costs, share of hard cost
soft_pct.assumption: Design, engineering, permits, TDLR registration, franchise application, legal, appraisal and construction interest. No limited-service split is published; 10% of hard cost is a working allowance for a rooms-only building.

ffe_per_key.label: FF&E per key
ffe_per_key.assumption: HVS reports a full-service FF&E median of $36,752 per key [^59]. A limited-service room carries no restaurant, ballroom or spa package, so we carry about half.

occupancy.label: Occupancy
occupancy.assumption: No Bastrop occupancy series exists in the record. U.S. hotels ran 62.3% in 2025 [^50]. The ramp opens below that while 228 extended-stay keys from 2025 and four pipeline hotels absorb demand [^23,36,15,20], and stabilizes at 66% to 67% on SH 71 business travel, the Starlink campus and Lost Pines leisure weekends.

adr.label: Average daily rate
adr.assumption: No ADR for Bastrop is published, and the aggregator prices in the research are undated asking rates, not ADR. We set $138 in Year 1, rising about 3% a year: below the 2025 U.S. ADR of $160.54 [^50] and the $156.56 select-service ADR in Apple Hospitality's Q1 2025 portfolio [^57], and above the $116.08 extended-stay average for Q4 2025 [^54].

other_rev_pct.label: Other revenue, share of rooms revenue
other_rev_pct.assumption: Meeting room rental, vending, pet fees and guest laundry at a rooms-only hotel.

payroll.label: Payroll and benefits (Year 1)
payroll.assumption: No Bastrop hotel wage data is in the record. Non-union U.S. hotels ran labor at 33.5% of revenue in 2025 [^58], a figure weighted to full-service hotels with restaurants. We carry about 23% of stabilized revenue, held as a fixed amount growing 3% a year so that payroll does not fall when revenue falls.

rooms_cost_pct.label: Rooms costs, share of rooms revenue
rooms_cost_pct.assumption: Linen, laundry, guest supplies, breakfast and online travel agency commissions. No published limited-service ratio was found.

franchise_pct.label: Franchise royalty, marketing and reservations, share of rooms revenue

mgmt_pct.label: Management fee, share of total revenue
mgmt_pct.assumption: The research found no 2025 to 2026 survey of management fees. 3% of revenue is carried even if the owner manages, so the projection pays for management.

undistributed_pct.label: Utilities, maintenance, sales and administration, share of total revenue
undistributed_pct.assumption: Undistributed expenses for a rooms-only hotel. CBRE's 2025 sample converted 34.8% of revenue to gross operating profit across all hotel types [^49]; limited-service hotels run leaner, which this ratio reflects.

insurance_per_key.label: Property and liability insurance per key
insurance_per_key.assumption: Insurance terms for the site were NOT FOUND. Bastrop County carries wildfire history (the 2011 Bastrop County Complex fire) [^66]; the lender must replace this with a bound quote.

tax_county.label: Bastrop County tax rate, FY 2026-27 (per $1 of value)

tax_city.label: City of Bastrop or ESD levy allowance
tax_city.assumption: The City of Bastrop's adopted 2025 rate could not be confirmed from a primary record; its tax page links only the 2024-25 ordinance [^7]. We carry a placeholder of $0.50 per $100 until the lender obtains the adopted ordinance or, outside the city, the ESD rate.

reserve_pct.label: FF&E replacement reserve, share of total revenue
reserve_pct.assumption: A reserve for room renovations and brand property improvement plans; 4% of revenue is a common franchise and lender requirement and is shown as a cost.

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: Prime was 7.00% on October 9, 2026 [^63]. Broker-reported 2026 all-in rates for hotel loans run 6.35% to 7.25% [^52]; we take the top of that range for a new-build hotel with no history. The lender sets the rate at pricing

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank first-lien amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: Matches the 25-year debenture; the bank term must be at least 10 years for a 20- or 25-year debenture under the SOP [^61].

growth_payroll.label: Payroll growth per year
growth_payroll.assumption: Payroll grows 3% a year, a labelled allowance for wage growth; the research gives no local wage trend for this use, so the lender should test it against the operator's staffing plan.

growth_insurance.label: Insurance growth per year
growth_insurance.assumption: Insurance grows 4% a year, a labelled allowance; no quoted premium for the subject exists, so a bound quote replaces it before closing.

growth_tax.label: Taxable value growth per year
growth_tax.assumption: Taxable value grows 2% a year, a labelled allowance; Texas appraisal districts reappraise, and the study does not forecast the district's value.

revenue.label: Rooms revenue
revenue.basis: keys x 365 x occupancy x ADR

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + keys * hard_cost_per_key * (1 + contingency_pct)) * (tax_county + tax_isd + tax_city) * (1 + growth_tax) ** y
